title: Get leaders to commit to the strategy
summary: A strategy only matters if leaders act on it. Bring them in before the final version, deal with objections and agree a clear decision.

beginner: List the leaders whose support you need.
Share the draft narrative with each one before any big meeting.
Write down their concerns and how you will answer them.
Hold a decision meeting with a clear ask.
Record the decision and who agreed.
intermediate: Use a decision framework so everyone knows their role.
Negotiate trade-offs openly rather than hiding them.
Agree how leaders will show their support, such as funding or announcements.
experienced: Handle disagreement between senior leaders directly.
Tie commitment to budgets and targets.
Keep leaders engaged after the launch, not just at sign-off.

toolExamples.confluence: Use a decision record with roles and the outcome.
toolExamples.google-docs: Track leaders' concerns and responses in one table.

pitfalls: Surprising leaders in a big meeting
